grammar.slot0: Position-only, then finite slot0 state retained before fitting residual slot1.

fitAndProgram.budgetQualification: Same declared maximum grammar/budget, different numbers of atoms actually used: 26 selected versus 23 control.
fitAndProgram.feedbackQualification: A discovery continuation policy, not a terminal quality gate. Initial and rejected half remain evidence.

dominantSlot1Leaf.qualification: Occupancy concentration is an observation, not a sufficient diagnosis of representational capacity.

novelPacket.qualification: Not eleven proven novel full-vocabulary tokens: pad ID is outside the active-literal set but appeared in historical packets. No native accuracy target.

metricSemantics.endpointErrorNormalizer: For each case/port/stratum, RMS(candidate endpoint - native endpoint) divided by RMS(native endpoint - H0 baseline at that same port).
metricSemantics.completeEndpointMetrics: predictionRMS, targetRMS and cosine in endpoint panels describe complete endpoints, not increment alignment.
metricSemantics.feedback: Discovery error/reference increment-energy ratio balanced under the frozen policy.
metricSemantics.pairs: Signed response across a fixed prompt pair; unchanged-token rows are a distinct causal-response panel.
metricSemantics.caution: H1 and Q/K/V have different native-increment denominators. Smaller Q/K/V percentages alone do not establish attenuation of the same error through the consumer.
metricSemantics.fixedPrefix: All512 panels include two exact fixed prefix rows. Learned-row panels separately use positions 2..511.

transfer.countertrend: Every transfer port has worse pooled padding error and more worsened than improved full-row endpoints versus the position-only control, despite better pooled all-row error. The two ties are the fixed prefix rows.

causalResponse.rowQualification: Some pre-edit unchanged-token rows have zero native response; do not describe each individual row as having 100% error. The pooled unchanged-token panels have nonzero native response and exactly zero predicted response.
causalResponse.interpretation: Same H0 at an unchanged token/position plus the same ordered writer atoms produces exactly the same finite H1. The row-local native RMS/QKV consumer preserves that equality. Current-token effects explain the nonzero whole-pair responses; those are not propagation to unchanged downstream rows.
causalResponse.workingInference: The learned endpoint-oriented routes select current lexical/family and position structure while ignoring the available edit-sensitive history features in these three contrasts. Endpoint fitting/selection plausibly contributes, but this run does not causally isolate objective choice from search limitations or dictionary capacity.
causalResponse.notAnExclusion: This is evidence against contextual propagation by this fitted program on these contrasts, not evidence that the permitted branch/writer family cannot represent contextual updates.

costs.warmLaterGatherQualification: Later cases reuse the lexical row cache; their timings are not independent cold-start latency estimates.
costs.timingScope: Worker time begins after imports/request reads and ends before final report write. Consumer timing includes hash capture; final child wall, CPU, fitting and data preparation have distinct scopes.
costs.memoryScope: Child ru_maxrss can include inherited pre-exec high water; it is not an isolated resident serving-memory measurement. Compiled dictionary/table costs remain paid.
costs.claim: No matched end-to-end speedup, no completed image, no eliminated historical teacher preparation.

nextCausalCut.recommendation: One contrast-aware refit under the same serving grammar and maximum budget, with slot0 frozen and no new histories, predicates, depth, dictionary capacity or teacher campaign.
nextCausalCut.why: Zero unchanged-token response is already localized to routing/atom choice for the observed contrasts. Test whether making the missing response visible to the fit and discovery consumer selection changes that behavior before expanding capacity.
nextCausalCut.candidate: Refit only slot1 routes and its at-most-16 writer atoms using the same four discovery histories and own features. Retain the executed endpoint program as the control.
nextCausalCut.loss: Use separately normalized endpoint error and signed unchanged-token paired-response error for the two discovery pairs. Freeze a single relative weighting before execution (equal weights is a reasonable first choice); do not tune it on transfer. Preserve both component losses and all strata.
nextCausalCut.finiteRule: Fit proposals may use ideal arithmetic offline, but execute exactly the existing ordered FP32-atom/BF16 admission program and evaluate its actual outputs. No finite-optimality claim.

coupledLeafFit.notation: For fixed routes let A assign rows to leaves, d be leaf vectors, r be the native residual after the actual frozen slot0 state, and D form signed unchanged-token pair differences.
coupledLeafFit.normalMatrix: lambda_E A^T W_E A/E_E + lambda_R A^T D^T W_R D A/E_R
coupledLeafFit.qualification: The fixed-route ideal normal matrix is a diagonal endpoint term plus a pair-graph Laplacian. Paired loss couples leaf vectors; ordinary independent CART leaf means are not its minimizer. A declared bounded heuristic is permissible but must not be called exact optimization. This is a mathematical proposal, not implemented or executed here.

nextCausalCut.consumer: Use discovery-only actual native RMS/QKV response for bounded continuation selection, with endpoint and response tradeoffs retained. Seal the final own predictions before releasing the two reused transfer targets.
nextCausalCut.controls: Keep original endpoint program, position-only program and H0 baseline; reuse already authenticated native/H0 outputs where exact identity permits. No prospective execution count is frozen in this actual-result receipt.
nextCausalCut.capacityAlternative: An oracle over the current frozen endpoint dictionary would only test those particular atoms, not the grammar with a different bounded dictionary. It is not required as a gate or selected as the next primary experiment.
nextCausalCut.mechanicsVersusScience: Only identity, finite schema, isolation, custody, exact restore and resource safety are blocking checks. Failure to improve a response is a preserved scientific observation, not an instrument failure.
nextCausalCut.status: Proposed next direction only; no additional fit, run, model execution or implementation performed by this review.
